title: One provider's models, regions and prices
description: What step 1 (gathering) writes for one provider, and step 2 (npm run model-list -w apps/worker) reads to generate the list of models and prices (docs/llm.md, "The list of models and prices: code, generated"). The same schema for every provider; the rules between files and those that differ by provider (only Bedrock has routings) are checked when the list is generated.

provider.description: The provider (a platform), as the app's code names it.

collectedAt.description: The day the information was collected (YYYY-MM-DD). The list's date is the oldest of its files'.

mock.description: True for made-up or unchecked contents, standing in until the real gathering.

sources.description: Where the information came from: the pages and files read.

models.description: The models the provider offers that the app lists.

id.description: The model's id in the app, the same on every provider (from the mapping kept by hand): configs refer to it.

name.description: The model's name for people, e.g. "Claude Opus 5.5".

string.description: The model string as this provider spells it.

regions.description: The provider's regions: "" for a provider without regions. On Bedrock, each with its routings and, for geographic routing, its geography.

geography.description: For geographic routing: EU, US, JP, AU.

prices.description: One price per model, region and routing, in US dollars per million tokens (the short-context prices; Claude's cache write is the 5-minute one).

model.description: A model's id, from this file's models.

source.description: What the price came from, for the spot-check (a file's entry, a page's table).
